profile.visual_desc: Muscular human in a deep navy hooded cloak and grey tunic. Distinctive long silver hair falls down the center of the back. Viewed from a rear-isometric angle.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic man with dark hair and a brown headband. Features a dark eyepatch over the right eye and a determined expression, framed by a blue hood.
profile.weapon_desc: Steel longsword with a red-accented hilt, held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing UP-LEFT. Character stands firmly with the sword held vertically in the right hand.
profile.step2_windup: Leans forward and spreads arms wide, coiling for a dash. The sword is held horizontally behind the back.
profile.step3_impact: Drops into a low lunge. A sharp, horizontal golden energy beam erupts across the screen, following the blade's trajectory.
profile.step4_finish: Stays in a low follow-through as the energy trail thins and vanishes, then begins returning to a standing pose.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The straight, horizontal golden energy beam in Frame 4 correctly aligns with the low-angled swing of the sword.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence follows the reference windup and release. VFX alignment is accurate. Biomechanics and camera perspective remain consistent.
